Here is a high-converting, modern product landing page design for "Workflow OS". 

I have structured this layout using a stunning **Gradient Hero** to capture attention immediately, followed by a **Feature Grid** split into three columns to highlight core value propositions, a highly-credible **Testimonial Card** with an avatar and star rating, and finally, an eye-catching **Shimmer Button** for the main call to action.

### 1. Initialize the UI Surface
First, we request the client to create a new surface for our product landing page.

<a2ui-json>
{
  "version": "v0.9.1",
  "createSurface": {
    "surfaceId": "product-landing-page",
    "catalogId": "https://a2uicatalog.ai/catalog/c-marketing-commerce.json"
  }
}
</a2ui-json>

### 2. Render the Landing Page Components
